name: Fey
mood: nocturnal Bloomberg terminal, matte-black with luminous type
summary: A dark fintech/product-showcase style with Fey Ink canvas, Fey Charcoal floating product cards, Calibre typography, 99px pill controls, 16px product-card radii, heavy black halo shadows, tight 48-54px display headlines, and color used as signal rather than decoration.

layout.model: centered dark fintech page with product UI as hero, floating product cards, 3-up feature grids, horizontal carousel rows, pill nav, dock control, and dark-room section rhythm

elevation.rule: Use a single deep halo, not stacked shadows.

dos: Use 99px radius for all interactive controls.
Set display headlines at 48px to 54px with -0.08em tracking and Calibre 700.
Use Fey Ink as the primary canvas and layer Fey Charcoal and Fey Obsidian for depth.
Use Ember, Signal, and Growth only as meaning-carrying accents.
Use 16px radius for content cards and product mockup surfaces.
Pair dark surfaces with a single heavy black shadow halo.
Reserve pure white for headlines and primary values.
donts: Do not use filled chromatic CTA buttons.
Do not introduce a secondary typeface.
Do not use zero or positive letter spacing on display sizes.
Do not use pure black as the page background.
Do not use Signal blue as a status color.
Do not add more than one chromatic accent per headline or card.
Do not stack multiple drop shadows.
